verdict.rationale: Steel publishes dedicated integration docs for the Claude Agent SDK (in-process MCP tools), the Vercel AI SDK, and CrewAI (browser exposed as a CrewAI tool). It also documents adapters for the OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI, AgentKit, and Browser-Use. Missing for 10: a documented LangChain adapter (one of the four named frameworks), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the adapters work as described.
